entities.name: Ural Tansykbayev Museum, Tashkent
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Ural Tansykbayev Museum, also known as the House-Museum of Ural Tansykbayev is a historic house museum dedicated to the Uzbek artist, Ural Tansykbayev located in Mirzo Ulugbek district in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. It also houses some of his paintings.
